#   path         relative to the base named in BASES (tools/corpus_ingest.py)

#   producer     the encoder that wrote the octets, with version
#   direction    the sender, as far as the rule knows it
#   same_compiler  yes when an asn1c build produced the octets (independent of our code,
#                  but not of our compiler; such a vector is never the only reading)
